name: cavemio-morphing-chart
title: Morphing chart
description: Bars, line and area as one set of marks: bars condense into beads, a thread is strung through them, the fill pours down. Drag the switch to scrub it.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Grey in a new shadcn project? Its default theme sets --chart-1 to --chart-5 to greys. Set five colours, light and dark, as in Theming › Chart colours (/ui/theming#charts).
- The shape switch is a radio group (arrow keys move and choose). Dragging the thumb is a pointer extra on top of it; it only starts from the selected shape, and a short press is still a click.
- The plot is one tab stop: arrow keys, Home and End read each point, Escape lets go, and the reading is announced. Every value is also in a visually hidden table.
- One frame loop writes path data and two transforms straight to the DOM and sleeps when nothing moves; nothing re-renders through React during a morph, a scrub or a slide of the bead.
- The line is a monotone cubic, so it never overshoots a value between two points, and the bead and the area's edge are evaluated on the same curve.
- Colour comes from the theme's --chart-1 (falling back to --primary). Reduced motion changes shape, data and the bead in place, and turns the thumb's drag off.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: labels
props.description: – · Along the bottom, one per value. They thin out from the latest when there isn't room.

props.name: values
props.description: – · One per label. New values ease into place; negative values are drawn at zero.

props.name: titles
props.description: – · Longer names for the readout, e.g. "October 2025". Defaults to labels.

props.name: onShapeChange
props.description: – · Called when the reader picks a shape, or lets go of the thumb on one.

props.name: title
props.description: "Revenue" · Above the figure. It morphs when it changes.

props.name: caption
props.description: – · Under the figure, e.g. "Last 12 months". The point's name takes its place while one is read.

props.name: format
props.description: – · How the figure and the readout read. The scale uses the same options in compact notation.

features.title: One set of marks, three shapes
features.description: Bars condense into beads, a thread is strung through them, and the fill pours down for the area.

features.title: Scrub the switch
features.description: Drag the switch’s thumb and the chart follows frame by frame. Let go and it runs on to the nearer shape.

features.title: Change your mind mid-way
features.description: Choose the shape you came from while it is moving and it runs back from where it is.

features.title: New values ease in
features.description: Heights ease to new values one after another while the scale’s labels roll.

features.title: A readout on hover
features.description: A bead rides the curve to the point, the figure rolls and its name morphs into the caption.

features.title: Remember the reader’s shape
features.description: Control the shape and save it per chart. Arrow keys read each point, and every value is also in a hidden table.

states.title: arrive
states.description: The first time the card is on screen every mark rises from the axis (650ms, up to 40ms apart) and the total and the scale roll up from zero.

states.title: bars → line
states.description: Each bar bulges a touch, pinches to a stick and retracts up into a 7px bead on its value, which hops 2px as it closes (460ms, staggered left to right). A thread then draws from the left through the beads (an exact cut of the curve, not a dash), and each bead shrinks to the thread's thickness under it as the tip passes. About 1.2s.

states.title: line → bars
states.description: The thread's tail is pulled to the right. Each bead swells back just before the tail leaves it, then lifts, drips a stick to the axis and spreads a little past the bar's width as it lands before settling (540ms).

states.title: line ↔ area
states.description: The fill pours down from the line to the axis, left to right (760ms), and drains back up into it on the way back (620ms). The wash fades from 22% at the top to 3% at the axis.

states.title: bars ↔ area
states.description: The bars widen until they touch and the solid fill fades to the wash; the steps they make melt into the curve while the line draws along the top. The reverse sets the curve into steps and parts them into bars.

states.title: scrub
states.description: Drag the thumb of the switch: the morph between neighbouring shapes is held at the frame under your finger. Let go and it runs on to the nearer shape, or the one you flung it toward; the thumb lands with a slight overshoot.

states.title: take it back
states.description: Choose the shape you came from while a morph is running and it runs backward from that frame. A third shape waits for the morph to land, then goes on.

states.title: data
states.description: New values ease to their heights one after another (650ms) while the scale's labels roll; on the line and the area the curve reshapes as they go.

states.title: hover
states.description: Bars dim to 32% except the one you're on. On the line and the area a ringed bead slides along the curve to the point (it rides the line, never cutting across it) with a thin line under it. The figure rolls to the point and its name morphs into the caption.
